name: TEEN TITANS
explanation: Teen Titans only lives as a legitimate tag synergy team because of Nightwing. You'll see better results going with Devotion's Nightwing Hypercarry above, but this one is quite nice for fans of the Teen Titans and anyone who just needs an extra team for ship combat. Cyborg can actually work as an off tank and so can Queen Hippolyta. There are some interesting TT/Amazons lineups you can run here.

name: TYVOKKA'S ARKHAM'S MOST WANTED
explanation: AMW used to be a dead tag synergy. With the addition of Riddler and Mr. Freeze, this is now one of the best teams in the game when heavily invested. Definitely a whale setup, but long-time non-spenders and lite spenders might be able to run this with good anvil usage. Standard flex options are included here. It's good to run an off-tank (Bane, Hawkgirl, Swamp Thing, or Scarecrow). Tyvokka set the table for the main three (Joker, Riddler, Freeze), and Quantum's Take here is you can really go several directions for the flex. Nurse Harley, Two-Face, Starfire, Zatanna, and Superboy can be used depending on whether you're looking for more DPS, healing, or ramp for your Joker. Some replacement options have been included to help F2P players think about how to build the team.

name: BAT FAMILY
explanation: Bat Family went from being a heavily panned failed tag synergy to one of the most robust as far as options for building from F2P to Meta over time. I'm including my personal recommendation for the core team right now, with viable replacements for non-spenders and new players. Orphan has shown promise as the secondary damage dealer in this team, but you can swap her out for one of the Red Hood variants as well. Note that this recommendation includes the new Mythic+ versions of Red Robin and Batgirl.

name: QUANTUM'S JUSTICE LEAGUE DARK
explanation: Standard JLD comp generally fares well in the meta. You can run this with Sinestro as a fifth for a really nice Meta Brawl team, and it's a team that is easy for F2P to build over the course of a year by focusing on a full JLD team to start. I'm offering you replacement recommendations for a free-to-play JLD build as well.

name: LEGION OF DOOM
explanation: LOD has tapered off for older servers, particularly with the downfall of the physical damage meta, but this is still a stout team. Make sure your Sinestro is the heaviest investment. I'm not including any viable replacements because honestly you NEED these core four if you want the team to work, but if you are a non-spender and know this will be your team long-term, you could technically run Killer Croc instead of Scarecrow, Black Adam instead of Sinestro, Lex as your anchor, Captain Cold in a flex spot, and something like Bane or Wonder Woman up front instead of Deathstroke. It's just a pretty low damage team long-term. You NEED a heavily invested Lex and Sinestro bare minimum for LOD.

name: QUANTUM'S AMAZONS
explanation: Amazons have shown good staying power in the meta if you have DMWW. Various hybrid comps can work here. The team has tapered off due to all the Physical Damage counters out there, but this is still a very solid 3v3 Strategic Challenge and Ship Combat team for spenders. There are a lot of options for flex here, but the general idea is to keep your DMWW and Artemis alive long enough for Artemis to win a duel and ramp DMWW up. Quantum's Take: Run two supports in the flex spots, ideally Starfire and Riddler. Alternatively, you could move Artemis backline and run Swamp Thing as one of the flex options.
